chart.description: Total number of eDTU used per database in an Elastic Pool vs eDTU limit
chart.name: # eDTU per database vs eDTU limit

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart.

chart.programText:
A = data('eDTU_used', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Sql/servers/elasticpools') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=2).sum(by=['azure_resource_name', 'databaseresourceid', 'subscription_id']).publish(label='A')
B = data('eDTU_limit', filter=filter('resource_type', 'Microsoft.Sql/servers/elasticpools') and filter('primary_aggregation_type', 'true')).sum(by=['azure_resource_name', 'subscription_id']).publish(label='B')
